source.description:
Cook and clean--that's all I do!

You want to eat, you get me some more meat! I don't have all day to hunt and prepare food for all these louses. You got to learn to pull your own weight around here if you wanna be treated equal.

Get me some Chunks of Boar Meat if you want to make yourself useful... or you don't want to starve to death.
